title: Workflow artifact tiers
description: Four artifact tiers between an idea and shipped code. Each tier has a distinct owner, scope, and lifecycle. Do not collapse them.

tiers.name: Spec
tiers.summary: Owns problem statement, decisions, requirements, open questions, done criteria, deferred items. Written before implementation begins.
contents: Relationship to other specs and plans
tiers.authority: If implementation drifts from the spec, the spec is the authority.

tiers.name: Plan
tiers.summary: Owns all decisions needed to write the code: function names, file locations, interfaces, data shapes, edge cases. Bridges spec → code.
contents: Write scopes per task (which files each touches)
Trace from each task back to a spec done criterion
tiers.authority: The plan is accountable to the spec; the plan's success criteria must trace back to the spec's done criteria.

tiers.name: Tasks
tiers.summary: Generated from the plan; updated as work progresses. Tracks status, dependencies, and write scope per concrete unit of work.
does_not_contain: Implementation prose (lives in plan or merge-back)
tiers.authority: Status is moved by `da workflow advance` / `delegation closeout`, not by hand.

tiers.name: History
tiers.summary: Archived at the end of a plan's lifecycle. Includes final PLAN.yaml + TASKS.yaml, impl-results (when applicable), delegation merge-back artifacts, and the original spec.
does_not_contain: Anything still actively planned (those live in .agents/active/ or workflow/plans/)
tiers.authority: Written by `da workflow plan archive --plan <id>`; never edited after.
